entradas.text: Petr, Valken and Iosef were seated.
The meeting concluded as the sun set over the concrete jungle that was Holsord.
“We knew that keeping the same budget for the military would cause for some concern from you.”
“It is a pleasure to work with you Iosef and Valken. You are true sons of Sordland who have served and continue to serve well.”
entradas.menu: “It is a pleasure to work with you Iosef and Valken. You are true sons of Sordland who have served and continue to serve well.”

entradas.text: “The military is a top priority for our administration and the Sordish people who hold it in high esteem.”
entradas.menu: “The military is a top priority for our administration and the Sordish people who hold it in high esteem.”

entradas.text: He cleared his throat.
“Once war or conflict comes knocking, that is when you will realize.”
“The Ministry of Defense is disappointed about the lack of additional funds.”
“We expected more.”
“To say that the Ministry of Defense is furious about the reduction of the military budget would be an understatement.”
“Rightfully so.”
“Hopefully the allocated money helps our defense needs.”
“The Ministry of Defense is content with the additional funds.”
“I'd be willing to support the military in other ways. We could come to an agreement.”
entradas.menu: “I'd be willing to support the military in other ways. We could come to an agreement.”

entradas.text: “Resources were more needed elsewhere. The military has always been well funded.”
entradas.menu: “Resources were more needed elsewhere. The military has always been well funded.”

entradas.text: “It is unfortunate that we weren't able to allocate resources. But, the decision is already made.”
entradas.menu: “It is unfortunate that we weren't able to allocate resources. But, the decision is already made.”

entradas.text: “This is a new age where the military is not top priority. We are going to transform to a new Sordland.”
entradas.menu: “This is a new age where the military is not top priority. We are going to transform to a new Sordland.”

entradas.text: “The increase of the military budget is for national security which is threatened by Rumburg and other nations.”
entradas.menu: “The increase of the military budget is for national security which is threatened by Rumburg and other nations.”

entradas.text: “The Sordish Armed Forces is a symbol of unity and strength.”
“Likewise, Mr. President.”
“We will do all that is necessary to protect this soil.”
“Should we move on to the spending choice?”
“Sure. I want to hear the suggestions.”
entradas.menu: “Sure. I want to hear the suggestions.”

entradas.text: “Very well.”
entradas.menu: “Very well.”

entradas.text: “The important thing is we put these funds to good use as the people will need proof of our success in the military.”
entradas.menu: “The important thing is we put these funds to good use as the people will need proof of our success in the military.”

entradas.text: “I'm sure that the people will approve something new and bold from us.”
“We surely will.”
“The increase of the military budget leaves us with big questions about how to utilize it.”
“There was a lot of debate at the Ministry which resulted in two factions of thought.”
“The first faction is in favour of enlarging the armed forces by enlisting more men while the second faction is in favour of purchasing better military equipment instead.”
“What is the argument for increasing the size?”
entradas.menu: “What is the argument for increasing the size?”

entradas.text: “What is the argument for purchasing better equipment?”
entradas.menu: “What is the argument for purchasing better equipment?”

entradas.text: “The armed forces are behind in terms of military equipment in comparison to our neighbours.”
“No matter how many advanced weapons and systems we buy, our enemies can overcome them.”
“Some of our neighbours have larger populations and thus a larger armed force.”
“Theoretically numbers alone don't determine the strength balance.”
Valken had a serious tone.
“Purchase better equipment and begin a modernisation programme.”
entradas.menu: “Purchase better equipment and begin a modernisation programme.”

entradas.text: “Enlarge the Armed Forces with an expansion programme.”
entradas.menu: “Enlarge the Armed Forces with an expansion programme.”

entradas.text: “Glad we made the right choice on this. I'll make the necessary arrangements.”
“Thank you for the right choice. The expansion will begin right away.”
“That is unfortunate but as you command, Mr. President.”
“As you wish. But the decision will be negative for our old doctrine.”
The generals were waiting for the word.
“That sounds bleak.”
“Enlisting more soldiers to the armed forces could also minimize the unemployment issue.”
Petr looked at Iosef.
“Quality over quantity, always. A smaller well equipped force can destroy a much larger one.”
entradas.menu: “Quality over quantity, always.”

entradas.text: “I don't think investing in better equipment is the way. It won't matter if the enemy outnumbers us.”
entradas.menu: “I don't think investing in better equipment is the way.”

entradas.text: “A vast Armed Forces is my preference. Quantity over quality in this case.”
entradas.menu: “A vast Armed Forces is my preference.”

entradas.text: “I'm not so convinced on this. What other reasons are there?”
entradas.menu: “I'm not so convinced on this.”

entradas.text: “I have settled on a decision.”
entradas.menu: “I have settled on a decision.”

entradas.text: “Sir, I will be frank. Rumburg fields three times our force.”
“I think we can agree on that.”
“Me neither.”
“The Sordish Armed Forces are already large enough.”
“We cannot beat an overwhelmingly large enemy like Rumburg without numbers.”
“We are heading to an era of modern combat which requires modern tools to adapt.”
“I hope the decision is in the interest of all.”
“I'd like to extend my thanks for your attendance.”
“Good work everyone.”
entradas.menu: “Good work everyone.”

entradas.text: “Have a good day.
entradas.menu: “Have a good day.”

entradas.text: “The military is important but it is not a priority right now.”
entradas.menu: “The military is important but it is not a priority right now.”

entradas.text: “We request any support we can get at this point.”
“We live in a geostrategic region with potential volatility.”
“How come a matter of defense has not been prioritised as more important?”
“Especially with the current political climate.”
“We know that there have been high hopes but the President has made his decision to prioritise other branches.”
“This is disastrous and will destroy the Armed Forces as we know it.”
“This is the age of Rumburg expansionism and here we are cutting funding for the military.”
“We need money and materials, Mr. President , not excuses.”
“I have been planning to improve the quality of the armed forces by buying better military equipment.”
“How would that be possible without funds?”
“It won't be.”
“If we relieve half the forces that could create enough of a surplus then we could invest in new equipment.”
“Relieving half the armed forces sounds risky at best and destructive at worst.”
entradas.menu: “Relieving half the armed forces sounds risky at best and destructive at worst.”

entradas.text: “Go on.”
entradas.menu: “Go on.”

entradas.text: Valken's eyes widened.
“We are barely matching the size of half our neighbours while the other half have armies two times bigger than ours.”
“How on earth would discharging half the armed forces and buying new gear solve our defense issues?”
“A better equipped smaller force is much more preferable.”
entradas.menu: “A better equipped smaller force is much more preferable.”

entradas.text: “Valken raises valid questions.”
entradas.menu: “Valken raises valid questions.”

entradas.text: “Quality over quantity is the right strategy for the future of warfare.”
“We are two decades behind in gear and training due to the size and sluggishness of the forces.”
“The reduction of the army would cause more unemployment which could hurt the administration.”
“Leave the military untouched. There is no reason to break a working structure and risk defense weakness.”
entradas.menu: “Leave the military untouched. There is no reason to break a working structure and risk defense weakness.”

entradas.text: “Reduce size and buy better equipment with surplus. Let's reform the army and create a smaller better equipped force.”
entradas.menu: “Reduce size and buy better equipment with surplus. Let's reform the army and create a smaller better equipped force.”

entradas.text: “Unfortunate but as you wish, Mr. President.”
“I can hardly say that I welcome this change.”
“Excellent. I shall begin the plans immediately.”
“The Sordish Armed Forces will stand strong. We'll maintain our structure.”
Iosef and Valken looked at each other.
“The military makes do. I'm sure you talented gentlemen will find ways to circumvent the cuts efficiently.”
entradas.menu: “The military makes do. I'm sure you talented gentlemen will find ways to circumvent the cuts efficiently.”

entradas.text: “We don't need a powerful military in this day and age.”
entradas.menu: “We don't need a powerful military in this day and age.”

entradas.text: “There is not much to be done. The sooner you accept the fact the better.”
entradas.menu: “There is not much to be done. The sooner you accept the fact the better.”

entradas.text: “You have broken promises but I did not expect you to betray the military.”
“Do not expect the Sordish Armed Forces to be a capable force after these budget changes.”
“Gentlemen. Please. Let's calm down. No need to cause a ruckus.”
“Tell that to the hundreds of thousands that will lose their employment and the honorable general staff of the Armed Forces.”
“You don't mean it but it has been done.”
“The Armed Forces is not as important as it claims to be. Therefore the right choice has been made.”
entradas.menu: “The Armed Forces is not as important as it claims to be. Therefore the right choice has been made.”

entradas.text: “We mean no insult to the Armed Forces. There are simply no resources left.”
entradas.menu: “We mean no insult to the Armed Forces. There are simply no resources left.”

entradas.text: “What will you do when a defense threat emerges? Call the police?”
“We expected much more from you, Mr. President. You have let us down.”
Iosef and Valken were angry, but there was not much that could be done about it.
“Thank you for keeping your promises.”
“Know that I won't ever forget your great deed.”
“We are surrounded by jackals as our intelligence and General Staff indicates.”
“It means a lot that the administration sees eye to eye with it.”
“I salute you for this right decision.”
“All spending topics will be addressed so the people can be proud of something that is theirs.”
“Our enemies are both outside and inside the country.”
“The President has always been supportive of our agenda because he has a strategic mind.”
“I knew I could trust you.”
“I have some suggestions already.”
“Using funds to boost our size would minimize their advantage.”
“We need a fundamental modernisation programme.”
“It is clear that the only real disadvantage is the one we have in numbers not equipment.”
“A modernisation programme won't mitigate our difference.”
“I don't think quantity should be our focus.”
“Reports show that we lack equipment not men for military efficiency.”
“The era of large assaults and human wave tactics are over.”
“The military circle has been moody after they heard the decision.”
“We are stuck between a rock and a hard place without money. The military suffers from budget overextension in order to keep up with other countries.”
“There is one way.”
“Having a large force doesn't necessitate superiority.”
“This was a betrayal in our eyes.”
“We will need to cut training time, let soldiers go and stop purchasing equipment.”
“Let's hope that our enemies won't realize our weaknesses.”
“Where exactly is our army deployed at right now?”
entradas.menu: “Where exactly is our army deployed at right now?”

entradas.text: “How do we compare to other armies?”
entradas.menu: “How do we compare to other armies?”

entradas.text: “This is low compared to 1000 to 1500 hours in other countries like Arcasia, United Contana, Lespia and even Valgsland.”
“Which branch would you like to know about?”
“The 1st Army is stationed at the Lespia and Wehlen borders to protect the way into the central regions of Sordland.”

“Rumburg fields six active field armies and two reserve armies, together surpassing one million soldiers in the field. Lespia maintains five armies. With ATO deployments included, their numbers rise to nearly 800,000.”
“Our navy is dwarfed by the Valgslandian fleet, which numbers 194 ships. Agnolia fields 81 vessels. They also maintain strong coastal defenses and heavy naval guns guarding their shores.”
“The truth is, we are limited to our near region due to the size and technological level of our naval ships.”
“How does our Navy compare to others?”
entradas.menu: “How does our Navy compare to others?”

entradas.text: “How are our capabilities in power projection?”
entradas.menu: “How are our capabilities in power projection?”

entradas.text: “This does cause some issues like friendly fire and missed close air support opportunities.”
“What is the situation of our army?”
entradas.menu: “What is the situation of our army?”

entradas.text: “Let's talk about our navy.”
entradas.menu: “Let's talk about our navy.”

entradas.text: “Our pilots have average experience. They have a total of 450 hours flight time with their craft before they are qualified. This gives them more than enough time to get used to it.”
“Our planes can bomb targets within 400 km radius of their airfield. They have medium range and semi-effective night-time bombing capabilities.”
“What are our operational capabilities?”
entradas.menu: “What are our operational capabilities?”

entradas.text: “How experienced are our pilots?”
entradas.menu: “How experienced are our pilots?”

entradas.text: “Can you provide the details on our air force?”
entradas.menu: “Can you provide the details on our air force?”

entradas.text: “What is the current equipment status?”
entradas.menu: “What is the current equipment status?”

entradas.text: “Our army is quite outdated by today's military standards. Most of our equipment is two decades old.”
“According to the latest reports from Camp Strongarm, currently, we field six armies totalling up to approximately 400.000 active troops.”
“Which seas does our Navy currently patrol?”
entradas.menu: “Which seas does our Navy currently patrol?”

entradas.text: “We are patrolling the Markian Sea, the Grey Strait and the Antacean Sea.”
“The Air Force is trained as an independent tactical support branch which means it assists other branches but doesn't collaborate.”
“How does our air force work together with other military branches?”
entradas.menu: “How does our air force work together with other military branches?”

entradas.text: “I am curious about another branch.”
“To make up for our lack of modern military equipment, we resort to a large number of soldiers which is not really a long term solution.”
“There are ways to improve collaboration with joint operation rooms. Something to think about surely.”
“I have been trying hard to reduce the negative effects of this problem. We don't need a modernisation program. A standardized purchase of lacking equipment would do.”
“Our navy currently constitutes 59 vessels with a total of 60.000 sailors and support staff.”
“We need more funding towards expanding the military size. Otherwise, our army will be seen as weak.”
“The 3rd Army is near the Agnolian border and the coastal areas facing Valgsland.”
“Which is a good amount. The real issue we are having is the quality, not quantity.”
“Due to our bitter past our coastal defense force is always on alert. The decimation of our fleet still is not forgotten.”
“Normally the hours per pilot should be higher but due to the lack of funding we can't increase the training times. Fuel costs are rather high.”
“The 2nd Army has a large mountain commando force and it is the most adequately equipped army to face Rumburg.”

“Valgsland fields one active army of around 140,000 troops, a significant portion of them marines. They also maintain three reserve armies that can be mobilized quickly due to their rapid mobilization military structure.”
“Very well.”
entradas.menu: “Very well.”

entradas.text: “Which one?”
“At any-time we can field seven air wings composing a total of 130 aircraft that can operate in combat duty. This is enough to subdue most targets.”
“Any specific one you want to know about?”
“As you know, these ships are commanded from our main naval base in Conriat where our flagship, SN Renan is docked.”
“30.000 pilots and support staff work in the Air Force and they are commanded from the Mark Air Force Base in Erlory.”
“Let's.”

“Rumburg’s sheer size stems from its forced conscription laws. In addition, several ducal regions maintain their own forces at their own expense, further bolstering the crown’s strength. They can sustain this scale thanks to their vast gold reserves, much of which flowed in from Rizia over the past decades.”
“The Lespian army is the most advanced. Arcasian investment and the Alvarez administration’s expansion of the military-industrial complex have accelerated their modernization.”
“I am not interested in the details.”
entradas.menu: “I am not interested in the details.”

entradas.text: “Lespia’s navy, while smaller at 39 ships, is heavily modernized and highly capable. That figure excludes the ATO fleet of Arcasia, which stations another 35 ships in Falenco and San Mantua.”
“Our air force currently has 410 planes in the inventory. Out of which only 140 are jet planes that are not in great condition.”
“Another thing to note is; after the takeover of Heljiland where our navy has led incursion operations to protect Agnolia, we also take part in some joint navy drills as well.”
“If we had modern support vessels, we could participate in international operations.”
“If we are to build a truly effective navy, our ships must be equipped with modern radar and sonar systems. Adding outdated vessels to the roster would change little.”
“I would like to know about the other branches.”
entradas.menu: “I would like to know about the other branches.”

entradas.text: “We often patrol the routes that are close to the shipping lanes. Especially Markian Sea and Grey Strait. The amount of cargo that goes through that area is eye opening.”
“Our navy protects all our coastal regions however, to make sure we are not thinning out our defense, we prioritise certain regions over others. Like Greater Holsord.”
“In terms of our bombing capability, we have an average of 100 meters of precision. This is not great but it is still within the effective radius of the bombs.”
“Let's hear about the other branches of the armed forces.”
entradas.menu: “Let's hear about the other branches of the armed forces.”

entradas.text: “We have prepared a briefing to convey further details about the current situation of our military.”
“General Valken. Mr. Lancea. Let's start with the briefing.”
To determine the current situation of the military and its spending policy, we held a meeting in the White Room.
“Very well, Mr. Vice President.”
“Actually, let's move on.”
entradas.menu: “Actually, let's move on.”

entradas.text: “The 2nd Army, our largest force, has been situated by the Rumburg border.”
“As you can see, the situation is serious. But the solution is not simply to commission more hulls.”
“That's right. We still hold *some* power though. If needed be, we could block the trade at the Markian Sea.”
“To make up for our weakness, allying ourselves to a naval power could also help protect our seas.”
“No need to go into details. I have already settled on a decision.”
entradas.menu: “No need to go into details. I have already settled on a decision.”

entradas.text: “No use complaining now, Valken. Let's look at what we can do with what we have.”
“Quality over quantity. I like it.”
entradas.menu: “Quality over quantity. I like it.”

entradas.text: “What do you think, Mr. President?”
“Dismissed.”
entradas.menu: “Dismissed.”

entradas.text: Iosef let out a long sigh.
“That will be all for today then.”
“First off, we have received an updated communication from the Arcasian military command.”
“Their planes are being moved into Erlory airbase as we speak.”
“Under our supervision of course.”
“Good. Make sure you keep an eye on them.”
entradas.menu: “Good. Make sure you keep an eye on them.”

entradas.text: “Do your best to make them feel at home.”
entradas.menu: “Do your best to make them feel at home.”

entradas.text: “Ensure that they do not forget which country's soil they are on.”
entradas.menu: “Ensure that they do not forget which country's soil they are on.”

entradas.text: “Of course, Mr. President.”
“We will try our best.”
Iosef and Valken looked at each other.
“First off, we have received an updated communication from the United Contanan military command.”
“We are keeping them under close surveillance.”
“Ensure that they do not forget which country's soil they are on.”
entradas.menu: “Ensure that they do not forget which country's soil they are on.”

entradas.text: “Of course, Mr. President.”
“Good. Make sure you keep an eye on them.”
entradas.menu: “Good. Make sure you keep an eye on them.”

entradas.text: “We will try our best.”
“Do your best to make them feel at home.”
entradas.menu: “Do your best to make them feel at home.”

entradas.text: Iosef and Valken looked at each other.
“A single wrong move and we will-”
“Despite my very vocal disagreement with the plan, their warships are approaching the Conriat naval base as we speak.”
“Contanan warships in Conriat. I thought I would never see the day.”
“We will keep you updated.”
“Do not cause any trouble. Do you understand?”
entradas.menu: “Do not cause any trouble. Do you understand?”

entradas.text: “Yes, sir.”
“Now let's move on to our military.”
“As if the reduction was not enough, you also decided against reinforcing our border.”
Iosef narrowed his eyes.
“If I didn't know better, I would say you are intentionally trying to weaken Sordland, Mr. President.”
“Of course not. How can you even suggest that?”
entradas.menu: “Of course not. How can you even suggest that?”

entradas.text: “You dare accuse me of treachery, Iosef?”
entradas.menu: “You dare accuse me of treachery, Iosef?”

entradas.text: “We are sorry but this had to be done.”
entradas.menu: “We are sorry but this had to be done.”

entradas.text: “Cause and effect. That's how I can suggest that.”
“Ridiculous.”
He did not respond.
We stared down each other. Petr finally interjected.
“Let's calm down, gentlemen.”
Iosef's voice was getting louder and louder.
“If Rumburg were to attack we would need to sacrifice many soldiers to hold the line now.”
“This will help our defensive situation to some degree. Units have already built dozens of pillboxes and trenches with tank traps. But it is not enough.”
“At the very least you decided to fund our new border fortifications against Rumburg.”

“Wehlen commands two armies totaling roughly 300,000 soldiers, though only their professional core is considered highly capable. Agnolia fields three armies amounting to 250,000 troops. They are well equipped, but have not seen combat in over three decades.”
“Valgsland follows closely. Although they prioritize economic development and social welfare in their budget, CSP funding has allowed them to remain competitive, keeping the gap with Lespia narrow.”

“Rumburg maintains 94 naval vessels. Intelligence suggests nearly a third of those are submarines. They also rely on other GRACE nations to help secure maritime routes and protect their trade networks abroad.”
